defect.locator_note: content_page.md treatment frontmatter and Treatment & subsequent history; lake/United States v. Morley__4e8574.json treatment.edges[0] and derivation.lane2_top_cited.
defect.problem: The page's unqualified good-law/no-negative-treatment presentation cannot be verified from the disclosed record because the lake treatment edges include a proposed overruled event from a later citing case.
defect.proposed_fix: Do not state 'No negative treatment' unqualified. Audit United States v. Lawrence Alexander; then either confirm good_law with a caveat that the proposed edge was rejected, or downgrade/limit Morley if the edge is validated.

reasons: The content page states Status good as of 2026-06-30 and says 'No negative treatment.'
The lake field_i_validity is good_law, but its treatment.edges array lists United States v. Lawrence Alexander with field_ii overruled and proposed true.
The same derivation section reports lane2_top_cited proposed_negative_events: 1, while no Alexander opinion text or authority record is disclosed to resolve the conflict.
residual_risks: Because the edge is proposed and field_iii is mentioned, the disclosed files do not prove Morley is actually overruled; they do defeat the unqualified no-negative-treatment assertion.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Replace the treatment note with: 'Lake field_i_validity remains good_law as of 2026-06-30, but one proposed overruled edge from United States v. Lawrence Alexander requires audit before saying no negative treatment.'
